# {{ site.title }}

> ChessDepth Academy is an online chess academy based in Bhopal, India. It teaches live online chess classes to children (from about age 5) and adults, from complete beginners to tournament players, with FIDE-rated coaches including Grandmaster Daniel Gormally. Students join from India and abroad. The website also offers free training tools: a daily chess puzzle, a blindfold chess trainer, a screenshot-to-FEN tool (ChessDepth AI), free printable worksheets and a chess blog.

Key facts:

- Format: live online classes over video with a shared board. Small groups of 2 to 4 students, or one-to-one.
- Fees: group classes ₹4,500 (about $69) per month; one-to-one classes ₹5,999 (about $90) per month. Each monthly plan has 8 to 10 live classes of 60 to 70 minutes. The first demo class (30 minutes) is free.
- Levels: beginner, intermediate, advanced and tournament preparation. Students are placed by level after the free demo class.
- Included: worksheets, a quiz every 8 sessions with coach feedback, club tournaments on Lichess and Chess.com, and a student area with PDF material.
- Ages: children from about 5 years old, teenagers and adults.
- Contact: WhatsApp or phone {{ site.contact.phone_display }}, email {{ site.contact.email }}. Book a free demo class at {{ site.url }}/#inquiry
- Location: {{ site.contact.address }} (classes are online, worldwide).

## Classes and coaching

- [Online chess classes for kids]({{ site.url }}/chess-classes-for-kids/): parents' guide to the kids' classes: ages, what children learn, fees, how the free demo works, FAQ.
- [Courses and fees]({{ site.url }}/courses/): all programmes, from beginner to tournament preparation, with monthly fees.
- [Coaches]({{ site.url }}/coaches/): the coaching team with FIDE ratings and profile links.
- [About]({{ site.url }}/about/): mission, teaching method, curriculum levels and student reviews.
- [Contact and free demo class]({{ site.url }}/contact/): phone, WhatsApp and email.

## Free tools

- [Blindfold chess trainer]({{ site.url }}/blindfold/): free browser trainer with 10 visualization drills, a 28-day plan, a daily blindfold puzzle and blindfold games against Stockfish (400 to 2800 Elo).
- [Daily chess puzzle]({{ site.url }}/#daily): a new puzzle from a real game every day, easier on Monday and harder by Sunday.
- [ChessDepth AI]({{ site.url }}/ai/): turns a chess screenshot or book diagram into a board and FEN, in the browser.
- [Free chess resources]({{ site.url }}/lab/resources/): study roadmap, Lichess game analyser, board editor, opening guide, endgame checklist and book list.
- [Chess Lab]({{ site.url }}/lab/): 64 courses including interactive lessons on chess thinking, strategy and pawn structures, a tactics trainer, Puzzle Streak, timed Puzzle Rush, 26 opening courses, an endgame trainer against Stockfish, a coordinates trainer and a progress dashboard.
